scope_note: These software-repository probes test Lilies as a Claude-style agent. They do not validate traditional-enterprise ML, RAG, data-artifact, or generated-workflow product outcomes.

formal_preflight_blockers: The current claude_like_coding_agent template has a fixed Read README.md tool execution path.
The current nested template loop allows only two iterations.
Dynamic model-selected Read, search, edit, Bash, test feedback, and continuation must pass the Click calibration three times before core runs.
Claude Code CLI is not installed, so no direct competitor run has been performed.
integrity_notes: No gold solution patch was mounted into or intended for any Lilies solver workspace.
Historical test patches were applied only to disposable coordinator probe copies.
Dependency installation used network access; the formal solve and evaluation phases must use network none.
These records prove baseline reproducibility only. They are not Lilies task results and they do not evaluate the platform-generated workflow product.
